name: Milion.Ai Connector
author: milionai

sections.description:
Milion.Ai helps businesses get found on Google and named in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews). This plugin connects your WordPress site to your Milion.Ai account, so the work you approve there is applied here safely.

  • Publishing: articles you approve in Milion.Ai are published with title, excerpt, categories, tags, featured image, meta description, focus keyword (Yoast SEO or Rank Math) and structured data (Article and FAQ schema).
  • Site fixes with undo: fixes you approve (SEO titles, meta descriptions, image alt text, insecure http:// links) are applied to existing posts and pages. The previous values are kept so every fix can be undone, content changes also create a normal WordPress revision, and a page someone edited after it was checked is never overwritten.
  • Comments inbox (optional): approved comments can be sent to your Milion.Ai inbox, where replies are drafted, approved by you, and posted back under your chosen author.
  • Site profile for AI assistants: serves an /llms.txt summary of your business and key pages, and adds your organization’s structured data (name, logo, contact details, social profiles) to the home page. Both are written in Milion.Ai, where you review them before publishing.
  • IndexNow (optional): notify Bing, Yandex, Naver, Seznam and other participating search engines whenever any post is published or updated. The key file is served for you.

Every request between your site and Milion.Ai is signed with a secret only the two share, expires after five minutes and can’t be replayed. The plugin has no tracking and adds no front-end scripts.

A Milion.Ai account is required. Every account starts with a free 14-day trial; paid plans are listed at milion.ai. The plugin itself is free and GPL-licensed.

External services

This plugin connects to the following services. Nothing is sent before you connect the plugin or turn the feature on.

Milion.Ai (https://app.milion.ai), the service this plugin connects to.
* When you connect: Milion.Ai sends signed requests to your site to publish approved articles, read a post’s title, description and content before proposing a fix, apply or undo approved fixes, and post approved comment replies.
* When “Comments” is on: each approved comment’s ID, the post title and address, the commenter’s name, the comment text and its date are sent to Milion.Ai. Email and IP addresses are never sent.
* When “AI crawler visits” is on: once an hour, the number of visits per day, per AI crawler (identified by its user agent, e.g. GPTBot or ClaudeBot) and per page path is sent to Milion.Ai. Requests from people are not recorded.
* Terms: https://milion.ai/terms/ · Privacy policy: https://milion.ai/privacy/

IndexNow (https://api.indexnow.org), when “IndexNow” is on.
* When a public post is published or updated, its address, your site’s host name and your IndexNow key are sent so participating search engines can recrawl it.
* About IndexNow: https://www.indexnow.org/ · The endpoint is operated with Microsoft Bing: https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement

Featured images: when Milion.Ai publishes an article with a featured image, WordPress downloads that image into your media library from the address Milion.Ai provides: a Pexels stock photo (images.pexels.com; https://www.pexels.com/terms-of-service/, https://www.pexels.com/privacy-policy/) or a cover image generated by Milion.Ai (app.milion.ai).

Privacy

The plugin stores its connection settings in your WordPress options. It does not track visitors, set cookies or load external scripts. With “AI crawler visits” on, it counts requests whose user agent belongs to an AI crawler; requests from people are ignored. If you turn on comment syncing, mention in your privacy policy that comments may be processed by Milion.Ai to help you reply.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin (Plugins → Add New → search “Milion.Ai Connector”).
  2. In Milion.Ai, open Connections → WordPress plugin, enter your site address and copy the connection code.
  3. In WordPress, go to Settings → Milion.Ai, paste the code, choose the author to publish as, tick the optional features you want, and save.
  4. Back in Milion.Ai, click Verify.
sections.faq:
Does Milion.Ai publish anything without my approval?

Only if you turn on auto-publish for this site in Milion.Ai, and only for content that passes every policy check. Everything else waits in your Approvals queue. Site fixes are always approved one by one (or “apply all” for a type) by a person.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

Yoast SEO and Rank Math: titles, meta descriptions and focus keywords are written to their fields. Without an SEO plugin, the plugin outputs the meta description and title itself.

Can I undo a fix?

Yes. Every applied fix can be undone from Milion.Ai. If the page was edited after the fix, its content is left alone (use WordPress revisions instead) so your later edits are never lost.

What happens when I deactivate or delete the plugin?

Deactivating stops all communication. Deleting removes the plugin’s settings and its undo backups. Posts, comments, SEO titles, descriptions and schema it created stay, because they are part of your content.
sections.changelog:
0.6.0

  • Page structured data: Milion.Ai can add JSON-LD (FAQ, service, breadcrumbs) to existing pages and posts once you approve it, with undo. It is printed in the page head like the schema of articles published from Milion.Ai.

0.5.0

  • AI crawler visits (opt-in): see in Milion.Ai which AI crawlers and assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Meta, Amazon, Apple and others) read which pages of your site.

0.4.0

  • Site profile for search engines and AI assistants: serves /llms.txt and adds your organization’s structured data (JSON-LD) to the home page, both written in Milion.Ai and published from there. Deleting the plugin removes them.

0.3.0

  • IndexNow and comment syncing are now opt-in (off until you turn them on in Settings → Milion.Ai).
  • Clearer descriptions of what each option sends, and a full list of external services in this readme.
  • Deleting the plugin also removes its undo backups.

0.2.0

  • Site fixes with undo: SEO title, meta description, image alt text and https links on existing pages.
  • Meta description output (without an SEO plugin) now covers pages as well as posts.

0.1.0

  • First release.
